attempts.summary: Established a WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1 (VyOS) so node3, which sits only on the shared default/egress network, can reach an app served by node2 on TCP 8080. node2's app is bound to a private eth1 network (10.50.50.0/24) shared only with node1; node3 has no other route to it. Since node3 is RHEL7 with a 3.10 kernel (no native WireGuard), wireguard-tools and wireguard-go (userspace) were built from source and wired into a persistent systemd wg-quick@wg0.service. node2's app runs under a systemd unit and is firewalled (firewalld zone bound to eth1 only) so it is reachable exclusively via the tunnel's routed path, not directly over the default network. All three nodes were restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol; boot_id changed on every node, and app/tunnel/route/firewall/systemd state was verified to recover fully post-reboot.
